title: Positive probability of the negated function
statement: For any function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, the uniform probability that $-f$ equals $1$ is the uniform probability that $f$ equals $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
